categories.main_business_segments: Lotte Energy Materials Corporation operates primarily in two segments: the materials segment, focusing on the production and sale of Elecfoil, a key material for lithium-ion secondary batteries and PCBs; and the construction segment, specializing in architectural exterior works including glass and window construction. The materials segment includes eight subsidiaries, while the construction segment comprises nine subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced electro-deposition technology to produce Elecfoil, a copper foil used as an anode current collector in secondary batteries and as a conductor in PCBs. It has developed Hybrid High-End Elecfoil with ultra-thin, high-strength, and high-elongation properties through over 30 years of R&D. The construction segment employs Curtain Wall construction technology, which reduces building load and shortens construction time, with customized manufacturing of window units.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international secondary battery manufacturers and PCB companies, particularly in the electric vehicle (xEV), energy storage system (ESS), and IT industries. The construction segment serves commercial and high-rise building projects domestically and internationally, including luxury brand flagship stores and large-scale architectural projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production facilities and subsidiaries in South Korea, Malaysia, Europe (Luxembourg, Spain, Hungary), and the United States. The materials segment has major production bases in Korea, Malaysia, and Europe, while the construction segment operates primarily in South Korea with some overseas projects in Canada, Australia, and the USA.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lotte Energy Materials is positioned upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer of core battery materials (Elecfoil) essential for secondary battery production. It supplies directly to battery and PCB manufacturers. The construction segment operates downstream, providing specialized construction and installation services for building exteriors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to maintain technological leadership in High-End Elecfoil production, focusing on next-generation battery materials such as solid electrolytes, LFP cathode materials, and silicon anode materials. It invests heavily in expanding global production capacity and enhancing product quality to meet growing demand from electric vehicle and ESS markets. The construction segment emphasizes technical expertise and design support to differentiate in competitive bidding.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of Elecfoil and related materials to battery and PCB manufacturers, both domestically and internationally. The construction segment earns revenue from contracts for architectural exterior works, including design, manufacturing, and installation services. The company also generates royalty income from licensing its intellectual property related to its core technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in Elecfoil production, competing with a few major players in Japan and China. It holds a strong market position due to its advanced technology and global production footprint. In construction, it is recognized as a top-tier specialist in Curtain Wall systems in South Korea, with a growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 809 billion KRW, showing a 10.9% increase from the previous year. Total assets stand at about 2.39 trillion KRW with a stable capital structure and a debt ratio of 21.7%. Despite a net loss in 2023 due to financial asset disposals, the company maintains strong cash reserves and is investing significantly in capacity expansion, indicating a growth trajectory aligned with the expanding secondary battery market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lotte Energy Materials offers uniquely differentiated High-End Hybrid Elecfoil products that simultaneously achieve ultra-thinness, high strength, and high elongation, meeting stringent customer requirements in advanced battery applications. Its global production network and commitment to eco-friendly manufacturing enhance competitiveness. The construction segment provides high-quality, technically advanced Curtain Wall solutions that improve building aesthetics and efficiency, backed by decades of experience and innovation.
